## Project Overview

## 2. Quality Control — PCA

```{r pca, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="PCA shows clear separation between tumor and normal samples along PC1 (31% variance), confirming strong biological signal."}
knitr::include_graphics("../results/figures/01_PCA_calidad.png")
```

**Interpretation:** PC1 explains 31% of total variance and cleanly separates 
tumor from normal tissue, validating data quality before differential 
expression analysis.

---

## 3. Differential Expression Results

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
res_df <- read.csv("../results/tables/DEG_anotado.csv")

cat("Total genes analyzed:", nrow(res_df), "\n")
cat("Significant DEGs (padj < 0.05):", sum(res_df$padj < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE), "\n")
cat("Upregulated in tumor (LFC > 1):", 
    sum(res_df$padj < 0.05 & res_df$log2FoldChange > 1, na.rm=TRUE), "\n")
cat("Downregulated in tumor (LFC < -1):", 
    sum(res_df$padj < 0.05 & res_df$log2FoldChange < -1, na.rm=TRUE), "\n")
```

### Volcano Plot

```{r volcano, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Volcano plot showing DEGs. Red points: significant by both adjusted p-value and fold-change. Top genes labeled."}
knitr::include_graphics("../results/figures/02_Volcano_DEG.png")
```

### Top 10 Most Significant DEGs

```{r top10, echo=FALSE}
top10 
  subset(!is.na(gene_symbol) & padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1) |>
  head(10)

knitr::kable(
  top10[, c("gene_symbol", "log2FoldChange", "padj")],
  digits = 3,
  col.names = c("Gene", "Log2 Fold Change", "Adjusted p-value"),
  caption = "Top 10 DEGs — Tumor vs. Normal (DESeq2)"
)
```

---

## 4. Hierarchical Clustering — Heatmap

```{r heatmap, echo=FALSE, fig.cap="Heatmap of top 50 DEGs. Unsupervised clustering correctly separates tumor (red) from normal (green) samples."}
knitr::include_graphics("../results/figures/03_Heatmap_top50.png")
```

**Key findings:**  
- **Upregulated in tumor:** COL10A1, MMP11, MMP13, KIF14, NEK2, PLK1, BUB1 
  — genes associated with cell proliferation, chromosomal instability, and 
  extracellular matrix remodeling.  
- **Downregulated in tumor:** LYVE1, CAV1, HSD17B13 — genes associated with 
  normal stromal and adipose breast tissue.

---

## 5. Methods

| Step | Tool | Parameters |
|------|------|------------|
| Data retrieval | TCGAbiolinks | STAR-Counts, hg38 |
| Low-count filtering | DESeq2 | rowSums ≥ 10 |
| Normalization | DESeq2 VST | blind = FALSE |
| DE analysis | DESeq2 | Wald test, padj < 0.05 |
| Gene annotation | org.Hs.eg.db | Ensembl → SYMBOL |

---

## 6. Conclusions

This pipeline successfully identified **15,931 differentially expressed genes** 
between breast tumor and normal tissue. Unsupervised clustering confirmed 
biological validity of results. Top upregulated genes (COL10A1, MMP11, NEK2) 
are consistent with published breast cancer literature, supporting the 
robustness of this analysis.

*Analysis performed with publicly available TCGA data. Full code available 
on GitHub.*
